title: tailnet-groups/1: who may open which door of a service behind tailscale serve (FAA-324)
description: The groups file an organization writes for a service that reads Tailscale-User-Login through fabric_tailnet_identity (Python) or fabric-tailnet-identity.mjs (Node). A login is allowed at a door for a capability when it belongs to a group that has a rule for that door listing the capability, or listing "*". Logins are compared lowercased as ASCII. One rule this schema cannot say and the module enforces: every rule's group is a key of groups. A file that is unreadable or breaks this schema closes every door of the service until it is fixed.

about.description: Free text for the people who keep the file; the service never reads it.

groups.description: Group name to its members' Tailscale login names.

door.description: dashboard: the service's pages; mcp: its MCP endpoint; service: its own door (an API, a webhook).

oneOf.description: The capability names the service asks for at this door (a page, a tool, an action).
